items.summary: Ensure the website prominently displays the institute phone number and physical address (in addition to email) in public-facing contact areas using the existing editable contact content (pageId: "contact"). Specifically, the Admissions & Contact page contact card and the global footer must show phone and address values (not omit them) and render phone/email as clickable links (tel: / mailto:) when non-empty.

Initialize a default "contact" page in backend content storage so phone/address/email are consistently available via getPage("contact") without requiring an admin save first. Use the existing frontend defaults (address, phone, email) as the initial values stored for this page.
